name: transfer_funds
description: This tool is used to perform a monetary transfer between a user's bank accounts, such as from a checking account to a savings account.

required_parameters.name: account_number
required_parameters.description: The unique identifier for the user's bank account from which funds will be transferred.

required_parameters.name: source_account
required_parameters.description: Indicates the account type or identifier from which the money will be debited (e.g., 'checking').

required_parameters.name: destination_account
required_parameters.description: Indicates the account type or identifier to which the money will be credited (e.g., 'savings').

required_parameters.name: amount
required_parameters.description: The amount of money to be transferred between accounts.

required_parameters.name: transfer_speed
required_parameters.description: Specifies the speed at which the transfer is to be made. The transfer can be 'now' for immediate processing, or 'scheduled' for a deferred transfer.

optional_parameters.name: schedule_time
optional_parameters.description: If the transfer is scheduled, this parameter specifies the date and time for the transfer to happen. Should follow the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS format.

result_parameters.name: transfer_status
result_parameters.description: Provides information on the status of the fund transfer, indicating success, in-progress, or failure.

name: get_account_balance
description: This tool retrieves the current balance for a specified bank account.

required_parameters.name: account_number
required_parameters.description: The unique identifier for the user's bank account for which the balance is to be retrieved.

result_parameters.name: balance
result_parameters.description: The current balance of the specified account presented in a string format, ideally including the currency symbol.

name: get_recent_transactions
description: This tool retrieves the most recent transactions for a specified bank account to identify regular activity and potential unauthorized transactions.

required_parameters.name: account_number
required_parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user's bank account from which recent transactions are to be fetched.

optional_parameters.name: transaction_type
optional_parameters.description: Optional filter to return transactions of a specific type. The default value is 'all', which includes every type of transaction.

result_parameters.name: transactions
result_parameters.description: A list of transactions made within the specified time period, sorted by the most recent. Each transaction includes details such as date, type, amount, and description.

transaction_date.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

transaction_type.description: The type of the transaction (e.g., deposit, withdrawal, transfer, payment).

amount.description: The monetary amount involved in the transaction.

description.description: A brief description or memo provided for the transaction.

name: freeze_bank_account
description: This tool places a hold on the specified bank account to prevent new transactions, in response to suspected unauthorized access or fraudulent activity.

required_parameters.name: account_number
required_parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user's bank account that needs to be frozen to mitigate potential fraud.

optional_parameters.name: freeze_reason
optional_parameters.description: The reason for freezing the account, which helps the bank in further fraud assessment and investigation.

result_parameters.name: freeze_status
result_parameters.description: Confirmation of the account being frozen and the subsequent status message indicating that the account is secured.
